hHqm4O0 = -1
if
    does_object_exist hHqm4O1
then
    delete_object hHqm4O1
end
hHqm4O1 = -1
return

:SCN_HQM4_RESET
hHqm4O0 = -1
hHqm4O1 = -1
return

// ---- scene HQM5: After The Open Experiment: the demo speakers and a souvenir barrier.
:SCN_HQM5_CREATE
request_model #SPEAKER_1
request_model #DYN_ROADBARRIER_5
:SCN_HQM5_LOAD
wait 0
if or
    not has_model_loaded #SPEAKER_1
    not has_model_loaded #DYN_ROADBARRIER_5
then
    jump @SCN_HQM5_LOAD
end
gosub @ANCHOR_PREP
// SPEAKER_1
fTmp7 = -1.6
fTmp8 = 1.35
gosub @ANCHOR_TO_WORLD
fSZ = fAZ
hHqm5O0 = create_object #SPEAKER_1 fSX fSY fSZ
fHead = fAH
fHead += 30.0
set_object_heading hHqm5O0 fHead
freeze_object_position hHqm5O0 true
// SPEAKER_1
fTmp7 = 1.6
fTmp8 = 1.35
gosub @ANCHOR_TO_WORLD
fSZ = fAZ
hHqm5O1 = create_object #SPEAKER_1 fSX fSY fSZ
fHead = fAH
fHead += 330.0
set_object_heading hHqm5O1 fHead
freeze_object_position hHqm5O1 true
// DYN_ROADBARRIER_5 from the SureThing demo
fTmp7 = -4.1
fTmp8 = 2.6
gosub @ANCHOR_TO_WORLD
fSZ = fAZ
hHqm5O2 = create_object #DYN_ROADBARRIER_5 fSX fSY fSZ
fHead = fAH
fHead += 90.0
set_object_heading hHqm5O2 fHead
freeze_object_position hHqm5O2 true
mark_model_as_no_longer_needed #SPEAKER_1
mark_model_as_no_longer_needed #DYN_ROADBARRIER_5
return

:SCN_HQM5_DELETE
if
    does_object_exist hHqm5O0
then
    delete_object hHqm5O0
end
hHqm5O0 = -1
if
    does_object_exist hHqm5O1
then
    delete_object hHqm5O1
end
hHqm5O1 = -1
if
    does_object_exist hHqm5O2
then
    delete_object hHqm5O2
end
hHqm5O2 = -1
return

:SCN_HQM5_RESET
hHqm5O0 = -1
hHqm5O1 = -1
hHqm5O2 = -1
return

// ---- scene HQATLAS: The complete cymatics atlas, on display.
:SCN_HQATLAS_CREATE
request_model #CJ_TV_TABLE1
request_model #CJ_SPHERE_TV
:SCN_HQATLAS_LOAD
wait 0
if or
    not has_model_loaded #CJ_TV_TABLE1
    not has_model_loaded #CJ_SPHERE_TV
then
    jump @SCN_HQATLAS_LOAD
end
gosub @ANCHOR_PREP
// CJ_TV_TABLE1
fTmp7 = -2.9
fTmp8 = 2.35
gosub @ANCHOR_TO_WORLD
fSZ = fAZ
hHqatlasO0 = create_object #CJ_TV_TABLE1 fSX fSY fSZ
fHead = fAH
fHead += 90.0
set_object_heading hHqatlasO0 fHead
freeze_object_position hHqatlasO0 true
// CJ_SPHERE_TV the atlas on loop
fTmp7 = -2.9
fTmp8 = 2.35
gosub @ANCHOR_TO_WORLD
fSZ = fAZ
fSZ += 0.52
hHqatlasO1 = create_object #CJ_SPHERE_TV fSX fSY fSZ
fHead = fAH
fHead += 90.0
set_object_heading hHqatlasO1 fHead
freeze_object_position hHqatlasO1 true
mark_model_as_no_longer_needed #CJ_TV_TABLE1
mark_model_as_no_longer_needed #CJ_SPHERE_TV
return

:SCN_HQATLAS_DELETE
if
    does_object_exist hHqatlasO0
then
    delete_object hHqatlasO0
end
hHqatlasO0 = -1
if
    does_object_exist hHqatlasO1
then
    delete_object hHqatlasO1
end
hHqatlasO1 = -1
return

:SCN_HQATLAS_RESET
hHqatlasO0 = -1
hHqatlasO1 = -1
return
